notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.
